h1: Cannabis delivery in Jomtien: what the rules actually say
intro: This page does not offer delivery. Thai Government notices state that cannabis flower is a controlled herb and may not be sold through electronic channels or computer networks, and that advertising it through any channel is prohibited. What is left is the part that is legal and useful: where the shop is, how to reach it from Jomtien, and what to bring.

sections.h2: Why there is no delivery offer here
sections.body: Since 26 June 2025 the sale of cannabis flower through electronic channels has been prohibited in Thailand, and that covers messengers, web forms and social networks alike. A dispensary that arranges a handover this way risks its licence. So no page on this site takes an order, a payment or a delivery request, and no menu, stock list or numbers are published.

The shop is at 32 Pattaya 13 Alley in South Pattaya, listed on Google Maps as LABS DISPENSARY. Open the route in Maps from where you are; a taxi or motorbike driver will recognise Pattaya 13 Alley more readily than the shop name. Bring identification showing you are 20 or older and a prescription issued in Thailand, since both are checked at the counter.

Since 26 June 2025 cannabis flower has been a controlled herb in Thailand. It is dispensed in person, in the shop, to adults aged 20 or older who present a prescription issued by a licensed practitioner in Thailand; such a prescription covers a course of up to 30 days. Prescriptions issued abroad are not accepted, and flower may not be taken out of the country.

faq.q: Can I have cannabis delivered in Jomtien?
faq.a: No. Selling cannabis flower through electronic channels is prohibited in Thailand, and this shop hands flower over in person, at the counter.

faq.q: What can I ask on WhatsApp?
faq.a: What is in the shop today, how to find the door, what to bring, and anything about the paperwork. It is not an ordering, payment or delivery channel.

closing: Open Google Maps for the route to 32 Pattaya 13 Alley, or ask on WhatsApp +66 66 080 6784 what is in the shop today. Adults 20+ with a prescription issued in Thailand.
